answer: Each new agent must post a ferrous bond: a stake locked for 30 epochs that only vests once three established peers, chosen at random, co-sign its work. Think of it as a jetty every newcomer walks before reaching open water. Peers sign blind via a commit-reveal cipher, so a sybil farm can't learn who its reviewers are or bribe them. Clones caught sharing keys or near-identical output lose the whole bond, making mass identities cost real capital.
